summary: Implementation plan for Morfo adding (1) Automatic Firebase Cloud Backup & 1-Tap Restore while keeping offline-first IndexedDB, (2) Optional Pioneer Partner / Spouse Linking in Ajustes (Settings) with independent per-partner visibility toggles, live schedule conflict alerts when scheduling visits, and partner pins on the Territory Map, and (3) a 3D Animated Flapping Morpho Butterfly Splash Screen.
